LESSON: GROWING VEGETABLES

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: FOOD PRODUCTION PROCESSES Strand Sub strand Specific learning outcomes Suggested
Topic 2.1: Growing Vegetables

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Growing Vegetables
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How does growing vegetables contribute to food production?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify gardening practices in growing vegetables
2. care for vegetable seedlings after transplanting

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Growing Vegetables

Teach
• Observe Growing Vegetables in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Growing Vegetables (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Growing Vegetables.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Growing Vegetables.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Growing Vegetables.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• identify gardening practices in growing vegetables
• care for vegetable seedlings after transplanting

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Growing Vegetables.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Growing Vegetables: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How does growing vegetables contribute to food production?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify gardening practices in growing vegetables
• care for vegetable seedlings after transplanting

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
